title: Old screw-fuse panel
why: Your house is from 1975 and the inspection report notes the original screw-fuse panel. Loose screw-fuse holders overheat and char the panel base, and panels from before 1985 usually have no residual-current device.
benefit: An electrician's check removes the most common cause of electrical fires in houses of this age. It raises your care score by up to 120 points.

mitigation.action: Electrician inspects the main panel and replaces it with automatic fuses and a residual-current device
